colleges.quote: CLINICAL DEGREE ... Tuition Fee 5,71,320 | 11,42,640 | 66,12,500 ... Total College Fee 7,07,320 | 12,78,640 | 67,48,500; PARA-CLINICAL DEGREE (Pathology,Microbiology,SPM) Tuition Fee 1,78,538 | 3,57,075 | 19,83,750; PRE-CLINICAL DEGREE (Biochemistry) Tuition Fee 80,937 | 1,61,874 | 10,58,000
colleges.notes: Scanned single page (read from image). Figures recorded = Tuition Fee row. Other rows, same in all three categories: Admission Fee 50,000; Registration/Application Fee 50,000; Skill Lab Training/Study Material 10,000; College Caution Deposit 25,000; PG Log Book 1,000 -> 'Total College Fee' clinical 7,07,320 / 12,78,640 / 67,48,500; para-clinical 3,14,538 / 4,93,075 / 21,19,750; pre-clinical 2,16,937 / 2,97,874 / 11,94,000. Period not printed (G.O. tuition is annual; whether the other heads recur is not stated). Note on sheet: 'As per APHREMC Guidelines, these fees will may be change. As of now, we collected fees as per G.O.Ms.No786, Dt 29-8-2026' (i.e. interim; equals G.O.Rt.786). C category is one column 'NRI/Institutional Quota' - entered twice as NRI and Inst.

government_all.scope: all candidates selected under the Competent Authority quota (government and private colleges) - university fee only, NOT tuition
government_all.year_label: PROSPECTUS ... COMPETENT AUTHORITY QUOTA ... ACADEMIC YEAR 2026-27, 9. FEE STRUCTURE
government_all.quote: University Fee: All the selected candidates shall pay the Non – Refundable University Fee of ₹.25,600/-
government_all.notes: Not a tuition fee. The CQ prospectus prints NO tuition figure for the older government colleges (AMC, Guntur, Kurnool, Rangaraya, SV MC, Siddhartha, Anantapuram, Kadapa, Ongole, Srikakulam, ACSR Nellore); only §9.2 for the five new colleges, and SVIMS's own pages. §9.1 (private colleges' Category-A tuition per G.O.Rt.786: 5,71,320 / 1,78,538 / 80,937) was NOT used (owner's rule). MQ prospectus: University Fee Rs.54,600/- for medical courses (MQ) - also not tuition; its private-college tables (§9.1) NOT used.
